1.evidence_source: Additionally, to explore the associations between age, BMI, early memories of warmth and safeness with close figures (EMWSS) and with peers (EMWSS_peers), social safeness (SSPS), body appreciation (BAS-2) and eating psychopathology (EDE-Q), product-moment Pearson correlations analyses were performed.
1._section_summary: This section describes the statistical analyses used: descriptive statistics and Pearson product-moment correlations were computed to examine associations among age, BMI, early memories of warmth and safeness (EMWSS, EMWSS_peers), social safeness (SSPS), body appreciation (BAS-2), and eating psychopathology (EDE-Q). Path analyses (using AMOS and Maximum Likelihood estimation) tested a mediation model with EMWSS variables as exogenous predictors, SSPS and BAS-2 as mediators, and EDE-Q as outcome, with bootstrap resampling (5000 samples) for indirect effects and multiple fit indices reported.
